## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` `placeYAxes` (it places `yAxes.slice(0, 2)`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the spec's `ChartConfig.yAxis` is an uncapped array, so a third entry validates, and then draws no axis and no note while its `title` / `format` / `min` / `max` are dropped (measured through `ChartRenderer`: 9 bars, no third label, 0 notes). A declared key silently unused past the second entry, with no named producer ⇒ p3. The axis family's card, objectui#10654, is closed (PR objectui#10686).

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:46Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: say so, ⛔ don't narrow. objectui does not own the `yAxis` face: the spec declares it uncapped, and a narrower objectui mirror would be a second spelling. So an entry past the second gets a visible note naming `yAxis[N]` through the note channel PR objectui#10647 / PR objectui#10686 use, and its series binding is stated. Pin a three-entry chart drawing the note, with the two-entry chart as the control.
